newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens ties up with Samsung.
newsitem.headline: Siemens ties up with Samsung.

text.p: German electronics giant Siemens AG said on Thursday its private communications systems division had agreed to cooperate with Samsung Electronics Co. of South Korea.

Samsung will market Siemens' Hicom telephones, and carry out service on these systems. Customer queries for millions of dollars in projects have already been received, the company said. The South Korean electronics market is estimated at 70 billion marks ($46.4 billion) a year, Siemens said.
